tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin_bio: Through a process of divination, children are selected for upbringing by the Sisters of the Veil, an order that considers assassination a sacred part of the natural order.  The Veiled Sisters identify targets through meditation and oracular utterances.  They accept no contracts, and never seem to pursue targets for political or mercenary reasons. Their killings bear no relation to any recognizable agenda, and can seem to be completely random:  A figure of great power is no more likely to be eliminated than a peasant or a well digger. Whatever pattern the killings may contain, it is known only to them. They treat their victims as sacrifices, and death at their hand is considered an honor. Raised with no identity except that of their order, any Phantom Assassin can take the place of any other; their number is not known. Perhaps there are many, perhaps there are few. Nothing is known of what lies under the Phantom Veil. Except that this one, from time to time, when none are near enough to hear, is known to stir her veils with the forbidden whisper of her own name: Mortred.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin_hype: The moment she finds her prey, Phantom Assassin strikes. Instantly closing in on a target, she effortlessly dodges attacks as she relentlessly cuts away at her foe. Without warning, any one of her attacks could prove suddenly and brutally fatal.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin_npedesc1: Blinks onto her foes with critical strikes

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** Interrupts Mortred's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
** This ability is in the {{Spellslot|3|6}}.

* The ability has three main components
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|phantom_assassin_blur_active}}
*** Applies the following ability effects on Mortred:
**** {{M|Disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
**** {{M|Invisibility}} that casting Mortred's other abilities does not break.
**** {{M|Untargetable}}
**** {{Symbol|Vision|Base}}
***** Mortred neither can be seen within the enemy's [[vision]] radius nor visible on the enemy's [[minimap]].
***** Does not grant immunity to the following vision-based mechanics:
****** {{M|Expose}} sources.
****** {{M|True Sight}} sources.
****** {{A|Faceless Void|Chronosphere}} from revealing her current position.
**** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} Applies the self {{M|basic dispel}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Basic Dispel}}
*** [[Dispel]]s {{Code|phantom_assassin_blur_active}} in the following conditions:
**** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Target|AreaAlt}}
***** {{#var:Blur value3}} seconds after getting within the dispel range of an enemy hero.
****** Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|towers}}, and {{M|Ancients}} as heroes; {{M|outposts}}, other {{M|buildings}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
****** This includes the enemy heroes affected by the following sources:
******* {{M|Hidden}} sources.
******* {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
***** Getting out of range during that delay does not prevent it from dispelling.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-3.png|3|21px]] {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|bonus cda}}
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Applies a [[Cooldown#Ratio|cooldown acceleration]] on the following abilities whenever the hero kill is credited to Mortred, regardless of how the kill was made:
**** {{A|Phantom Assassin|Stifling Dagger}}
**** {{A|Phantom Assassin|Phantom Strike}}
**** {{A|Phantom Assassin|Fan of Knives}}
**** Stacks multiplicatively with other percentage-based {{Symbol|bonus cda}} {{Symbol|bonus cdi}} {{M|cooldown reduction}} sources.
*** Does not apply to the following ability sources:
**** {{A|Phantom Assassin|Blur}}
**** Item abilities.
**** Ultimate abilities.
*** This includes the following kill sources and conditions:
**** {{M|Reincarnation}} sources.
**** An ally hero kill.
**** Self-damage {{M|deny}} with certain sources.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_phantom_assassin
data.bio_loc: Through a process of divination, children are selected for upbringing by the Sisters of the Veil, an order that considers assassination a sacred part of the natural order.  The Veiled Sisters identify targets through meditation and oracular utterances.  They accept no contracts, and never seem to pursue targets for political or mercenary reasons. Their killings bear no relation to any recognizable agenda, and can seem to be completely random:  A figure of great power is no more likely to be eliminated than a peasant or a well digger. Whatever pattern the killings may contain, it is known only to them. They treat their victims as sacrifices, and death at their hand is considered an honor. Raised with no identity except that of their order, any Phantom Assassin can take the place of any other; their number is not known. Perhaps there are many, perhaps there are few. Nothing is known of what lies under the Phantom Veil. Except that this one, from time to time, when none are near enough to hear, is known to stir her veils with the forbidden whisper of her own name: Mortred.
data.hype_loc: The moment she finds her prey, Phantom Assassin strikes. Instantly closing in on a target, she effortlessly dodges attacks as she relentlessly cuts away at her foe. Without warning, any one of her attacks could prove suddenly and brutally fatal.
data.npe_desc_loc: Blinks onto her foes with critical strikes
